notes.text: Read 2026-11-20. The sheet is headed 20 and has the lighter footer 41. It resumes generalized morphisms of ordinary graphs and calls those satisfying condition 1°) of (48) morphismes de générisation. The author describes determination up to iso by the source graph and a stable arc part, defines the complementary subgraph, and states that its component set identifies with S, giving (49). Formula (50) identifies the remaining arc set with B-tilde-prime and adds compatibility with the involutions. This is a reading summary only; no independent proof of those assertions was checked. No explicit authorial doubt statement is added or inferred.

The small hooked ink below the opening source G is newly preserved with doubt. Its position resembles a low annotation, but it might be an incidental pen trace; no mathematical role is asserted, and it is not normalised to the clear bullet notation introduced later. The crossed prefix before compatible is also newly preserved with a tentative c. The original cancelled superscript uncertainties remain at both the opening target G and the A in (50).
